seoTitle: Third Luminous Mystery: The Proclamation of the Kingdom | Rosary Book
seoDescription: A read-aloud decade book for children on the Third Luminous Mystery, the Proclamation of the Kingdom: the story, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a reflection.
h1: The Proclamation of the Kingdom: Third Luminous Mystery
intro: A little read-aloud book for one decade of the Rosary: The Proclamation of the Kingdom.
shortAnswer: This book walks children through the Third Luminous Mystery, the Proclamation of the Kingdom: a short story, the Gospel passage, the Our Father, ten Hail Marys and the Glory Be, and a reflection on conversion and Christian witness.
aboutHtml:
Painting: Carl Bloch, Sermon on the Mount. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Image source (Wikimedia Commons).

The Gospel passage is quoted word for word from the Douay-Rheims Bible, 1899 American Edition, which is in the public domain; verse numbers are omitted for reading aloud, and … marks skipped verses. The Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be and Fatima prayers follow the standard formulas used across this site. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Thursday.

faq.q: What is the Third Luminous Mystery?
faq.a: The Proclamation of the Kingdom. Jesus walked through Galilee preaching: The kingdom of God is at hand; repent, and believe the gospel. This mystery is traditionally prayed on Thursday, and its fruit is conversion and Christian witness.

faq.q: How do you pray this decade with children?
faq.a: Read one page at a time. On the decade page, pray the Our Father once, the Hail Mary ten times (one for each bead), then the Glory Be and the Fatima prayer.
